messages.subject: S4 review: PASS
messages.body: Reviewed S4 at head ec5b1f5fb0dce6391174a03b8989d6bde9844f96 against AC-2: all four claims (nested links, inline HTML vs code spans, combining marks, shared label/slug text) hold under probes and the 88-test suite is green with CRLF/marker code untouched. Found one medium issue (autolink <http://x> is stripped as an HTML tag so that heading is omitted from the TOC) plus a few low/info items, and duplicate-suffix-vs-depth behavior is correct but has no guarding test. Nothing blocking; the coordinator may want a follow-up for autolinks, and no worktree files were modified.
